The '''Interpreters''' were the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] that interpreted and deciphered the meanings of the vision held by the [[Voss Mystics]]. Their role was crucial in the Voss society, as all visions were obeyed without question. However, while the visions were never ever wrong, the Interpreters could from time to time make mistakes in interpretations.
